# Retro City

Retro City is Prince Lionel's original pegasus mare, best remembered as the aspiring Wonderbolt in PrinceWhateverer's *Odds Against Us*. Think of her as a fellow dreamer in Rainbow Dash's world: a determined flyer who overcomes ridicule with the support of friends. Her story belongs to the fan-created song's continuity; no official G4 episode, film or comic appearance was verified.

- **Appearance:** Winged mare associated with Cloudsdale, according to the creator-linked [roleplay profile](https://canterlotavenue.com/Retro-City). Her precise coat, mane, eyes and cutie mark could not be verified visually.
- **Name:** Retro City is the OC's established name, not a nickname assigned to a Hasbro background pony. Prince-Lionel's reference sheet was featured on April 17, 2017, as item 41 in [Equestria Daily's Drawfriend #2232](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2017/04/drawfriend-stuff-pony-art-gallery-2232.html). No alternate identity was verified.
- **Speaking status:** The song narrates her story in the first person. PrinceWhateverer and Sable Symphony are the credited musical performers; a character-specific speaking voice credit could not be confirmed.
- **Appearances and art:** The original song's [Bandcamp release and cover artwork](https://princewhateverer.bandcamp.com/album/odds-against-us-comm-ft-sable) credits Ak4neh for the art and Prince Lionel for the OC (April 10, 2020). CyanLightning also drew her alongside Spitfire in [Drawfriend #3086, item 25](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2019/09/drawfriend-stuff-pony-art-gallery-3086.html). An acoustic rendition appears on [Just Relax](https://princewhateverer.bandcamp.com/album/just-relax) (May 17, 2025). Direct image assets could not be verified, so no image is embedded.

## Important moments

These are narrative beats from the song [Odds Against Us](https://princewhateverer.bandcamp.com/track/odds-against-us-comm-ft-sable) (2020), rather than television episodes. Video timestamps could not be verified.

- **Facing her shortcomings** — Retro acknowledges her past mistakes but refuses to give up on her ambition.
- **Standing up to ridicule** — She resolves to make a name for herself and draws strength from someone who believes in her.
- **Achieving her dream** — The closing verse depicts her receiving the crowd's acclaim after overcoming the obstacles, completing her journey toward becoming a Wonderbolt.
